Telemetry.subject: Health & Medicine
Telemetry.question: In the US and the USSR, the _____ system was quickly replaced with better systems; in both cases, based on pulse-position modulation (PPM)
Telemetry.fact: The German V-2 rocket used a system of primitive multiplexed radio signals called "Messina" to report four rocket parameters, but it was so unreliable that Wernher von Braun once claimed it was more useful to watch the rocket through binoculars. In the US and the USSR, the Messina system was quickly replaced with better systems; in both cases, based on pulse-position modulation (PPM).

Telemetry.subject: Health & Medicine

Telemetry.fact: In the United States, early work employed similar systems, but were later replaced by pulse-code modulation (PCM) (for example, in the Mars probe Mariner 4).

Telemetry.subject: Health & Medicine
Telemetry.question: These services are known as _____ while drilling and Logging while drilling
Telemetry.fact: In short, telemetry is the enabling technology (remote measurement and data transmission), while telematics describes the integrated, digitalized applications that build on telemetry to deliver business, safety, and operational insights. These services are called Measurement while drilling and Logging while drilling.

Telemetry.subject: Health & Medicine
Telemetry.question: This information is used for _____ evaluation, Drilling Optimization, and Geosteering
Telemetry.fact: Information acquired thousands of feet below ground, while drilling, is sent through the drilling hole to the surface sensors and the demodulation software. The pressure wave (sana) is translated into useful information after DSP and noise filters.

Telemetry.subject: Health & Medicine
Telemetry.question: Systems used in series such as _____ have become advanced to the point where the potential lap time of the car can be calculated, and this time is what the driver is expected to meet
Telemetry.fact: Systems used in series such as Formula One have become advanced to the point where the potential lap time of the car can be calculated, and this time is what the driver is expected to meet. In Formula One, driver input is also recorded so the team can assess driver performance and (in case of an accident) the FIA can determine or rule out driver error as a possible cause.
